title: [review] lib.rs: Division by zero panic if superframe_duration_us i
description: sfn_from_unix_time divides by superframe_duration_us without checking for zero. GnssHopConfig has public fields, so callers can construct it with superframe_duration_us = 0, causing a panic. Consider adding a guard (return 0 or saturate) when superframe_duration_us is 0, or validate in GnssHopConfig constructor.
